title: How do you draw a wave with half circles?
description: A wave is drawn along a central line AB of eight centimetres, with a half circle above the line and then a half circle below it. The video finds where the compass tip goes and what opening to use. Keeko raises the doubt about setting the compass to the whole flat side.
teaching_notes: One idea: the opening of the compass is half of the flat side of a half circle, and the tip goes in the middle of that side. Watch for children who set the opening to the whole flat side.

source: Wavy Wave. Construct this. Let us take AB to be the central line such that AB = 8 cm. Here, the first wave is drawn as a half circle.
video_script.why: The child places the compass tip in the middle of a flat side and sets the opening to half of that side.
video_script.substitution: Line AB of eight centimetres, with X halfway, and half circles on each half.
video_script.anchor: The wave along the central line AB of the book
video_script.wrong_answer: set the compass to four centimetres
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko sets the compass to four centimetres, the whole flat side. The half circle would then be eight centimetres wide, twice as wide as AX.
video_script.payoff_line: Both half circles use an opening of two centimetres.

final_answer.value: AB = 8 cm, AX = XB = 4 cm; opening 2 cm; first tip 2 cm from A, half circle above; second tip 6 cm from A, half circle below
final_answer.spoken: both half circles use an opening of two centimetres; the tips are two centimetres and six centimetres from A

never_show: the finished wave before the answer
maths_rules: AB = 8 cm; X is halfway, so AX = 8 / 2 = 4 cm and XB = 4 cm.
The opening is half of AX: 4 / 2 = 2 cm.
First tip: 2 cm from A, half circle above AB from A to X.
Second tip: 4 + 2 = 6 cm from A, which is 8 - 6 = 2 cm from B; half circle below AB from X to B.
Slip: an opening of 4 cm gives a half circle 4 + 4 = 8 cm wide, twice as wide as AX.
video_script.design: One idea: the tip goes in the middle of the flat side and the opening is half of that side. Assumes the compass is set against a ruler. Wrong idea: opening equal to the whole flat side. The line AB stays all video.
